title: Youknowlando - Playing a Chord
htmlContent:
Youknowlando's "Playing a Chord" is that engaging Hip Hop that will never go out of style. He commands your attention and let’s it be known he is an emcee, that must be respected and admired with his incredible skill set that it is truly gold standard. The pen is incredible, the flow is hard, and it’s all delivered on the right production that comes together to make an amazing Hip Hop experience.
